title: They came to Bergerac to learn French

items.text: Many thanks for a week full of good things: your warm welcome, your superb cooking, your teaching. Everything prepared with precision and kindness, all the cultural and social expressions… A very rich week, full of ideas, discussions and even a little grammar — and all with humour.
items.name: Ann

items.text: The lessons were excellent and the atmosphere friendly. I highly recommend this experience to anyone who wants to improve their French.
items.name: Christina
